name: se
description: Refine ideas, create feature specs with actionable tasks, save to GitHub or Markdown, and deliver reviewed changes.

interface.shortDescription: Specify features, plan tasks, and deliver reviewed changes.
interface.longDescription: SE supports repository-grounded refinement, feature specifications, and reviewed delivery. Spec creates one coherent spec with actionable tasks and saves to GitHub or one Markdown file. Delivery uses the current task to coordinate isolated native subagents for a whole spec or selected tasks. It requires independent candidate review, explicit @codex review on ready PRs, current CI and assembled outcome verification, with two repair rounds per PR. Safe pauses preserve work and release repository claims; resume reconciles existing evidence. Progress updates remain separate from semantic requirements. Learn maintains project knowledge; Idea captures proposals; Implement handles bounded local work and repairs; Review PR requests or resumes hosted Codex review, waits, and reports the provider result without subagents or repairs; Audit observes active SE workflows. Merge, deployment and releases remain separately authorized.
defaultPrompt: Use $se:grilling to sharpen a topic, $se:study to investigate it, or $se:learn to preserve knowledge.
Use $se:spec to create a feature spec and actionable tasks, saving to GitHub or one Markdown file.
Use $se:review-pr for hosted review, $se:adversarial-review for local critique, or $se:deliver-features for PR delivery.
